subject: one round pool of still pale steel-blue water seen from above at a steep angle, one round white moon reflection in its centre, a narrow rim of silver-grey sand with eight pebbles; framed like the fairy ring
prompt:

Reference image 1 is a sibling card: a round patch of ground seen from above at a steep angle and drawn as one single object on white. Match its framing, its viewing angle, its size in the frame and its ink outline; do not copy its toadstools or its grass.

Draw: the Silver Pool. One round pool of perfectly still water, seen from above at a steep angle so it reads as a slightly flattened oval. The water is a flat pale steel-blue grey, clearly darker than white paper, and in its centre lies one soft round white reflection of a full moon, about one fifth as wide as the pool. Around the water runs a narrow band of pale silver-grey sand, about one tenth as wide as the pool, with eight small smooth grey pebbles set along it. The outer edge of the sand is drawn with a continuous dark ink outline.
Style: plain vanilla Card Survival game art: flat colour fills in three or four tonal steps, a thin continuous dark brown-black ink outline, muted natural colours, no glossy highlights, no decorative patterns, no cartoon, no comic shading. Single object only, in the lower two-thirds of the frame, comfortably inset from every edge, isolated on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) that fills every edge of the frame, no ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
